## EA Media Tools 2.0.1 - jaguar

### Encoder defaults

- Every built-in preset uses NVENC high-quality tuning while retaining its selectable P1-P7 speed preset.
- `presets.ini` now stores tune and perceptual-quality defaults separately for NVENC, AMF, QSV, VA-API, VideoToolbox, and software encoders.
- Encoder changes select the matching family defaults instead of reusing an unrelated backend's quality number.

### Batch metadata

- Metadata-only mode adds **Apply to all sources in queue** after the selected source is edited.
- Only fields changed on the selected source are propagated to corresponding streams in queued inputs of the same type.

### Installation footprint

- Packaged Windows launches retry obsolete Squirrel installation cleanup, keeping only the current application version.
- Logs archived by old releases are deleted, and a prior-version active log is reset on first launch.

### Interface fixes

- Encoding speed no longer displays a malformed separator or a duplicated NVENC P-level.
- Advanced encoder settings use readable backend names, and decoder status appears before Queue with hardware/software glow indicators.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and production packaging.

[Review all changes since v2.0.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1).
